notable: MARC 将 Zetrix AI 的 sukuk 评级下调至违约，涉及未支付的 RM25M。

recent_en: Zetrix AI is facing multiple financial and legal pressures: MARC downgraded its sukuk to default, the government sued over RM314M in JPJ arrears, and the company said it is currently unable to repay the RM2b outstanding under its sukuk programme. It has proposed ring-fencing and bullet payments to clear RTD arrears.
notable_en: MARC downgraded Zetrix AI's sukuk to default over unpaid RM25M.
The government filed a lawsuit against Zetrix AI over RM314M in JPJ arrears.
The company proposed ring-fencing and bullet payments to clear RTD arrears.
risks_en: The company said it is currently unable to repay the RM2b outstanding under its sukuk programme.
AmanahRaya wrote down Zetrix AI bonds to zero, pressuring the NAV of three suspended funds.
The company faces material litigation involving RM314M in JPJ arrears.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM426.7M, up 10.5% QoQ and 38.6% YoY; net income was RM269.3M, down 0.8% QoQ but up 35.2% YoY; net margin was 63.1%, lower than 70.2% in the previous quarter.
